The Commission shall be chaired by the Secretary
of Trade and Industry and co-chaired by the CORDs for
Regions I and CAR.
The Commission shall have the following functions:
Review and submit to the President, for approval,
the NWIGQ Master Plan and Development Program;
£)
Provide overall direction, coordination and
supervision in the planning, implementation and j
monitoring of all program/project components and
development activities of the NWIGQ Development
Program in consultation and coordination with the
Joint RDC-CEB Interregional Consultative Council;
Cause the update, refinement and endorsement of
the NWIGQ plans, investment programs and projects
within the context of the NWLGO Master Plan and
the Regional Development and Physical Framework
Plans and Investment Programs of Region I and CAR.
Cause the preparation of feasibility studies for
and financing of the various projects identified
for the NWIGQ;
Encourage the support and assistance from
government and non-government institutions in
planning and implementing the various projects
under the NWIGQ Development Program;
Organize the Program Management Office
define its organizational set-up, establish its
staffing pattern as well as internal operating
systems, and procedures;
Review and confirm contracts entered into by the
Director of the
Program Management
Review and endorse to the Department of Budget and
Management (DBM) the annual budget of the NWIGQ
Development Program including
Financial Plan for the operation of the PMO;
Submit to the President, progress reports on the
NWIGQ Development Program and such other reports
as may be required.
Program Management Office.
The Program
Management Office (PMO) shall serve as the implementing arm
as well as technical and administrative secretariat of the
Commission, and as such, shall undertake the day to day
activities of the NWIGQ Development Program.
headed by an Executive Director to be appointed by the
The DTI Regional Office shall provide office
space and technical and secretariat support to the
Commission on an interim basis until such time that a
staffing pattern for the PM shall have been determined and
approved by the Commission.
Fiscal austerity will be
observed strictly.
The Program
Management Office shall perform
following functions:
Coordinate with implementing bodies including
local government units, line agencies, financing
institutions, non-government organizations and
other concerned entities in the updating,
refinement, endorsement and implementation of the
NWLGQ Master Plan and investment programs and
Coordinate with the Local Development Councils
(LDCs) in the implementation of policy decisions
promulgated by the Commission;
Coordinate the preparation of feasibility studies
of the project components of the NWIGQ Development
Program and the evaluation and financing of
feasible projects;
Coordinate the preparation of the annual budgetary
requirements of the NWIGQ Development Program and
submit the same to the Commission;
Undertake periodic review and evaluation of the
NWIGQ Development Program and shall, for the
implementation, monitoring and evaluation system
consistent with the Regional Project Monitoring
and Evaluation System (RPMES) and enhanced with
Planning Programming Budgeting Monitoring and
Evaluation (PPBME and impact evaluation and;
Perform such other functions and responsibilities
as the Commission may direct.

entities of the
Commission. In case where national line
agencies are designated as lead implementing entity,
implementation shall be undertaken in close coordination
with concerned local government units.
Joint Inter-regional Consultative Council.
There is hereby created a Joint Inter-regional Consultative
which shall be composed of three
(3)
representatives from the Regional Development Council (RDC)
counterpart group from the
Cordillera
Administrative Region
(CAR) to be composed of three (3) I
representatives of the Cordillera Executive Board (CEB) E
and three (3) representatives of regional line agencies
(RLAs) whose head offices are members of the NEDA Board, all
of whom shall be chosen from among themselves. The Joint
Inter-regional Consultative Council shall
serve as the
Commission's inter-regional advisory group.
Role of Local Development Councils.
Local Development Councils of the program area shall perform
the following functions:
Approve the respective local components of the
multi-year and annual plans and investment
programs under the NWIGQ Development Program;
Monitor and conduct periodic review of the local
project component with respect to achievement of
goals, objectives and targets of the
Development Program;
Coordinate and facilitate the preparation of site
specific development plans, programs and projects;
Coordinate the passage of municipal and/or
provincial resolutions declaring the areas for
industrial and tourism use, if not yet declared or
classified as such;
Coordinate with the Provincial/Regional Land Use
Committees and Sanggunians concerned on the review
and approval of the land use and zonation plans of
NWLGQ component sites;
Spearhead the coordination of area inter-agency
activities
area/province
jurisdiction in the implementation of the NWIGQ
Development Program; and
Perform such other functions as the PMO may
Operational Requirements.
The amount of
Five Million Pesos (P5,000,000.00), to be drawn from the
DII funds for Locally-Funded Projects, shall be released for
the initial operational requirement of the Commission for
the year 1994. Appropriations for the succeeding years for
the operations of the PMO shall be incorporated in the
budget proposals under
Department of Trade and Industry
The Term of the Commission and the Program
Management Office.
The Commission and Program Management
Office shall have a term corresponding to the implementation
period of the NWIGQ Development Program. The NEDA Board is
hereby directed to conduct a regular review and evaluation
of this management and coordinating structure and recommend
revisions as may be deemed necessary.
Effectivity.
This Executive Order shall
take effect immediately.
DONE in the city of Manila this 30T
day of April in
the year of our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Ninety Four.
